Name: Espresso Replacer
Author: dragonsir
Description:
I love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6092]Coffee Replacer[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50271396]lamplight12347[/url], but the triple-shot espresso looks so out of place next to it! So, I decided to change that.

This only modifies the texture of the triple-shot espresso, no other data is edited. I tried to make it match lamplight12347's coffee style so they look even cuter together.
[size=5]
Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
